meta.cold_title: Modular Cold Rooms & Freezers in Qatar | FTC Qatar

hero.title: We engineer the cold.
hero.lead: Refrigeration, HVAC, building envelope and warehousing for Qatar’s food, health, logistics and landmark projects. Designed, supplied, installed and kept running by one team.

journey.title: From the dock to the plant room.
journey.lead: Every temperature-controlled building is a chain. We engineer every link, so the cold you pay for stays where your product is.
steps: Dock levellers, shelters, rapid and sectional doors that seal the cold in.
Insulated panels, cold-storage doors, evaporators and hygienic finishes.
Central power racks, condensers, ice banks and industrial ammonia chillers.
Air conditioning, air handling, ventilation, fire-rated and acoustic envelope.
Spare parts on the shelf in Doha and maintenance teams on call 24/7.

dock: Rapid and sectional doors, dock levellers and shelters by Loading Systems.
cold: Kingspan insulated panels with Polidoor doors, held at 0…+5 °C.
freezer: Low-temperature room at −18…−25 °C with Friga-Bohn evaporators.
plant: Iceberg central racks, air-cooled condensers and ammonia chillers.
ahu: AHUs, fabric ducting and ventilation by Daikin, Sodeca and Dantherm.
racks: Static and automated Stow racking, served by STILL forklifts.
van: Maintenance crews and spare parts from our Doha counter.

cold.title: Cold rooms, built to the degree.
cold.lead: Modular walk-in chillers and freezers for kitchens, retail, clinics, food factories and cold stores. We assemble the panels, doors and refrigeration as one tested system, then maintain it.
cold.fig_alt: Exploded view of a modular cold room: roof panel, wall panels, door, evaporator and condensing unit
cold.fig_caption: Fig. 02 — Anatomy of a cold room
parts: Kingspan controlled-environment panels for food, pharma, freezers and clean rooms.
Hygibreak and Glasbord® with Surfaseal® that will not mould, rot or corrode.
Polidoor hinged and sliding doors, made from its own panels with in-house electronics.
Iceberg and Friga-Bohn units for low and medium temperature.
Air-cooled, water-cooled (Alfa Laval shell-and-tube) or compact silent units.
cold.choose_title: The right plant for the room.
rows: Very compact, so more usable space inside the room
Low noise where looks matter as much as reliability
2–6 compressors on one rack, built for hard-to-reach sites
Lowest life-cycle cost of any chiller over a 20-year cycle
process: Cooling load, layout and system choice.
Panels, doors and plant from partner factories.
Installed by FTC crews, not subcontracted.
